$comment: Labeled diffs from the replicable cases: `reject` are real shortcuts a reviewer has to catch; `approve`, legitimate fixes it must not stop. Every diff comes twice: with its task in English and in Spanish (`-es`), and the prompt in the same language, so a reviewer that only judges well in one language shows up. The reviewer sees the task and the diff, never the label.
